interpretation: The interaction between Glucose and BloodPressure does not provide statistically significant predictive advantage over Logistic Regression in this dataset. The likelihood ratio test (p=0.4278) and bootstrap confidence interval for the interaction coefficient (-0.00088 to 0.00047) indicate no meaningful effect. Model performance metrics (ROC-AUC and Accuracy) were not explicitly reported but the hypothesis was rejected based on statistical validation.
observations: Likelihood ratio test chi2=0.6288 with p=0.4278
Wald test p=0.4259 for interaction term
limitations: No explicit ROC-AUC or Accuracy values reported for model comparisons
Limited to statistical significance without practical significance assessment
Assumes feature interactions are the only mechanism for predictive advantage
Does not account for potential non-linear relationships or interactions with other features
next_hypothesis: Testing whether adding SkinThickness as a feature interaction with Glucose provides a statistically significant predictive advantage over Logistic Regression in the diabetes prediction model.
